item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible 2024 public example of Sisi creating or empowering an independent civilian ombudsman, inspector general, special prosecutor, parliamentary inquiry, or other body with real reach over abuse by the NSA, military, prisons, or other politically protected actors. The record is mostly impunity, not institutional accountability.","evidence":[{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Egypt","publisher":"U.S. Department of State via ecoi.net","date":"2025 report covering 2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128475.html","summary":"The report says the government in some cases reported investigations into torture/cruelty complaints that led to disciplinary measures against Interior Ministry employees in 1,217 incidents. This is the clearest limited complaint-handling signal, but it is administrative and does not show truly independent oversight or accountability for politically protected actors.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/egypt","summary":"HRW reports that prosecutors refused a request to reopen the investigation into economist Aymad Hadhoud’s forced disappearance, ill-treatment, and suspicious death in custody. That is direct evidence against independent investigation of serious abuse.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2","2B.9"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"May 13, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty says a detainee who criticized Sisi was beaten and electroshocked, and prosecutors did not investigate the abuse complaint or refer him for forensic examination. This shows complaint handling and abuse review were ineffective when politically sensitive actors were involved.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"Jul. 18, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Amnesty reports NSA agents blindfolded and ill-treated detainees while prosecutors charged them under broad security offenses. This is evidence that due process and abuse complaints did not meaningfully constrain the security apparatus.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2","2B.6"]},{"title":"Egypt: “Handcuffed like dangerous criminals”: Arbitrary detention and forced returns of Sudanese refugees in Egypt","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"Jun. 19, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde12/8101/2024/en/","summary":"Amnesty says Border Guard Forces and police carried out mass arbitrary arrests of Sudanese refugees, held them in cruel and inhuman conditions, and forced returns without asylum access. This is strong evidence against usable civilian complaint or oversight channels for abuses by state forces.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"President El-Sisi meets Prime Minister and members of the new government","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"Jul. 3, 2024","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-el-sisi-meets-prime-minister-and-members-of-the-new-government/","summary":"Sisi told the new government to strengthen institutional frameworks, improve coordination across ministries and state agencies, and emphasize integrity and transparency. This is weak, indirect evidence in favor of institutionalized governance, but it is not proof of independent oversight or complaint adjudication.","question_ids":["3B.4","2B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt","publisher":"Human Rights Watch / Amnesty context page","date":"Oct. 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/es/middle-east/n-africa/egypt","summary":"Amnesty notes parliament approved some alternatives to pretrial detention, including curfew, electronic monitoring, and house arrest. This is a small due-process improvement, but it does not amount to a robust oversight or independent investigation system.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1"]}]}
